source_scope: The three checked-in local knowledge files configured in sources.json. The configured python-news URL is excluded: the existing six-chunk cache is stale, and the current page is a navigation-heavy listing; no verified byte-identical snapshot is retained. No linked article pages are included.
tokenizer: retrieval-tokenizer-v1: lowercase ASCII alphanumeric tokens; punctuation separates tokens; no external corpus or model

chunking.reason: Use the legacy CosineOverlap benchmark's improved chunk settings consistently across the retrieval variants; record this separately from production defaults.

label_schema.evidence_cluster: facts and paraphrases sharing evidence remain in one split
label_schema.answerability: answerable or unanswerable relative to these three indexed local sources
label_schema.relevant_passages: source_id, verbatim quote, relevance grade (1 contextual, 2 directly answers); evaluator resolves the quote to chunk IDs for this frozen source fingerprint and chunk configuration

labeling_method: Questions were written from the checked-in source claims. Each answerable label includes an exact source quote and source ID; unanswerable labels have no supporting quote after checking all three complete files. No expected answer text is stored. Automated quote-presence and source-hash tests validate the annotations. This is source-checked by the implementation author, not independently reviewed by a second human; obtain human review before treating it as a portfolio-grade benchmark.
review_status: source-anchored draft; independent human review pending
split_method: Evidence-cluster split: all paraphrases for a fact share one split. Multi-passage combinations are held out as combinations. Unanswerable probes are in test. This tiny corpus does not support statistically powered generalization.
limitations: The local corpus is only 1,235 bytes and 11 factual sentences; several query variants necessarily share evidence.
No date or numeric answer is present in the local indexed knowledge files; date/number probes are unanswerable in this corpus.
The dynamic python-news source is excluded from this version until a byte-identical project-loader snapshot can be retained and reviewed.
No independent human relevance reviewer has signed off on these annotations.
This set is diagnostic only and cannot support statistically meaningful quality claims.
